A [[Bolt of Damask]] is a rare crafting material. It is used in the crafting of [[armor]].

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[rare material trader]]s.
* Select [[artisan]]s will craft one Bolt of Damask for 5 [[Plant Fiber]]s, 5 [[Pile of Glittering Dust|Piles of Glittering Dust]] and 200 {{gold}}.
* [[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from:
** Any armor crafted using Bolts of Damask (see below).
* Possible drop from [[Hidden Treasure]].
* No [[creature]]s currently appear to [[drop]] [[:Category:Drops damask|Bolts of Damask]], nor do there appear to be any [[salvage item]]s, [[Trophy|trophies]] or [[weapon]]s that [[:Category:Contains damask|contain Bolts of Damask]].
